item.title: VLA Deep Dive (Part 2): The pi0 Family and Action Interface Evolution
item.description:
VLA Series (3 parts): Part 1: RT-2 to OpenVLA | Part 2 (this article) | Part 3: VLA and World Models

In Part 1, we walked through RT-2, OpenVLA, and OFT, seeing the foundational architecture and six evolution axes of VLA. OFT’s results revealed a key signal: the action interface itself is an important system design axis. Starting from this article, we enter the more technically dense part – the three generations of the pi0 family.
